reviews.title: Great buy
reviews.comment: Works as expected too. No complaints when I am talking to others.
reviews.author: Patrick C.

reviews.title: It’s good at what it does
reviews.comment: Because I have the original hyper cast I can’t change the color so this works great. It does its job well as a pop filter and fits well on the mic. Good bang for your buck.
reviews.author: Will Currey

reviews.title: Almost close to perfect.
reviews.comment:
I got the hypercast from 2019 not the RGB version, I think you would see the mic a bit clearer with that but you can barely tell if it's on or off you can easily tell if it is if you look closely enough, just keep turning it till you see little red lights going through it.
You need to remember which mode is which because this blocks it, would be cool if it didn't.
reviews.author: Matt

reviews.title: Works as intended
reviews.comment: Works as intended - just wish there was a way to see the lights so I know when I am accidentally muted
reviews.author: Tess W.
